mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in real GDP growth signals a weakening economy that will produce negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid rise in unemployment signals a weakening labor market and slowing economy, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns in triggered periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: An accelerating rise in industrial production signals strengthening economic growth that will produce positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in housing starts signals a weakening housing market and consumer demand, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 55% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid rise in the federal funds rate signals a tightening monetary policy that will produce negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns in triggered periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in real retail sales signals strengthening consumer demand that will produce positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid rise in nonfarm payrolls signals strengthening labor market and economic growth that will produce positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid rise in CPI inflation signals overheating demand that will trigger monetary tightening and produce negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns in triggered periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.1), or FEDFUNDS does not rise > 0.5% in the following 3 months.
